not_claimed: Elaborating sorry statements proves their truth.
This package reruns or contains the linked mathematical proofs.
This package is an official part of formal-conjectures or has been contributed to it.
The package provides an independent new proof or human expert review.
Compatibility with upstream Lean 4.33.1 or its full linter suite.

A3.scope: Full A3 classification for 0 < l < k; literal Definition 1(a), not a classification of all fullerenes.

AffineRays.scope: Specification-level eventual periodicity under Valid and TrianglesInCharts. The bridge from the paper geometric hypotheses is prose, not a Lean theorem.

K3.scope: Eventual periodicity on every positive-domain affine ray, including boundary rays with one parameter equal to 1. No K3 classification declaration is included.

C1.scope: Classification for r,s >= 1 and eventual periodicity on positive-domain rays; the IPR clause is outside these statements.

O2.scope: Absence for t,d >= 2; eventual periodicity for rays starting in t,d >= 1. No extra existence cases are asserted.

D14.scope: Eventual periodicity on positive-domain rays only. The supporting no-path lemma is not added as a separate challenge statement.

E10.scope: Classification for p,s >= 1 and r >= 2; eventual periodicity on positive-domain rays includes r = 1. No r = 1 closed classification is asserted.

Heesch.scope: Six conditional CNF soundness statements: Hh/Hc on square/hexagon/triangle grids; arbitrary counter-input permutation, K >= 1, valid hole blocks, and unsatisfiability hypotheses retained. No numerical Heesch values or certificate executions.

D12.scope: Closed classification for r,s >= 1: integer r divides s-1 or s+1, or abs(r-3*s)=1; literal-path eventual periodicity for all natural positive starts and nonnegative slopes, including parameter-one boundaries and constant rays. Explicit quotient-model definitions retained.

theorem main (k l : ℕ) (hl : 0 < l) (hlk : l < k) :
    (∃ n p, LiteralPath (gcGraph k l) n p) ↔ criterion k l
claims.scope: Full A3 classification for 0 < l < k; literal Definition 1(a), not a classification of all fullerenes.

claims.statement_lean:
theorem main (S : Sig) (t₁ : ℕ) (hval : ∀ t, t₁ ≤ t → Valid S t ∧ TrianglesInCharts S t) :
    ∃ t₀ P : ℕ, 0 < P ∧ ∀ t, t₀ ≤ t → (PathExists S t ↔ PathExists S (t + P))
claims.scope: Specification-level eventual periodicity under Valid and TrianglesInCharts. The bridge from the paper geometric hypotheses is prose, not a Lean theorem.

claims.statement_lean:
theorem main (r₀ s₀ a b : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r₀) (hs : 1 ≤ s₀) :
    ∃ t₀ P : ℕ, 0 < P ∧ ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
      (PathExists (r₀ + a * t) (s₀ + b * t) ↔
        PathExists (r₀ + a * (t + P)) (s₀ + b * (t + P)))
claims.scope: Eventual periodicity of PathExists on every natural affine ray with both starting parameters >= 1 and nonnegative slopes, including constant rays and rays with a parameter fixed at 1. No K3 classification is asserted by this declaration.

claims.statement_lean: theorem classification (r s : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hs : 1 ≤ s) : PathExists r s ↔ s = 1
claims.scope: For natural r,s >= 1, PathExists r s holds if and only if s = 1. The IPR clause is outside this statement.

claims.statement_lean:
theorem classification (p r s : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    PathExists p r s ↔
      ∃ d : ℤ, (d = 0 ∨ d = r ∨ d = r + s) ∧
        ((p : ℤ) ≡ d + 1 [ZMOD 2 * r + s] ∨ (p : ℤ) ≡ d - 1 [ZMOD 2 * r + s])
claims.scope: For natural p,s >= 1 and r >= 2, PathExists p r s holds if and only if p is congruent to d+1 or d-1 modulo 2*r+s for some integer d in {0,r,r+s}. No closed classification for r = 1 is asserted.

claims.statement_lean:
theorem main (p₀ r₀ s₀ a b c : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p₀) (hr : 1 ≤ r₀) (hs : 1 ≤ s₀) :
    ∃ n₀ P : ℕ, 0 < P ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
      (PathExists (p₀ + a * n) (r₀ + b * n) (s₀ + c * n) ↔
        PathExists (p₀ + a * (n + P)) (r₀ + b * (n + P)) (s₀ + c * (n + P)))
claims.scope: Eventual periodicity of PathExists on every natural affine ray in (p,r,s), with p0,r0,s0 >= 1 and nonnegative slopes. Includes r = 1 boundary rays and constant rays.

claims.statement_lean:
theorem hh_sound_square (ord : Cell → List ℤ → List ℤ) (hord : ∀ c g, (ord c g).Perm g)
    (S : List Cell) (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (blocks : List HoleBlock)
    (hblocks : ∀ b ∈ blocks, b.Valid squareGrid (K - 1))
    (hunsat : ¬ Satisfiable (cnfOrd squareGrid ord S K blocks)) :
    ¬ ∃ tiles : Tiles, IsCoronaHh squareGrid S.toFinset K tiles
claims.scope: On the square grid (squareGrid), for any cell list S, K >= 1, counter-input ordering ord that preserves each input list up to permutation, and hole blocks valid for squareGrid at K-1, unsatisfiability of cnfOrd squareGrid ord S K blocks implies that S.toFinset has no K-layer corona in the Hh sense. Unsatisfiability is a hypothesis; no numerical Heesch value or certificate execution is asserted.

claims.statement_lean:
theorem classification (r s : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    PathExists r s ↔
      ((r : ℤ) ∣ (s : ℤ) - 1 ∨ (r : ℤ) ∣ (s : ℤ) + 1 ∨ |(r : ℤ) - 3 * (s : ℤ)| = 1)
claims.scope: For natural r,s >= 1, PathExists r s holds if and only if, after casting to integers, r divides s-1, r divides s+1, or abs(r-3*s) = 1. This declaration does not state the separate ray result; the explicit quotient-model definitions are retained.

claims.statement_lean:
theorem main (r₀ s₀ a b : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r₀) (hs : 1 ≤ s₀) :
    ∃ n₀ P : ℕ, 0 < P ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
      (PathExists (r₀ + a * n) (s₀ + b * n) ↔
        PathExists (r₀ + a * (n + P)) (s₀ + b * (n + P)))
claims.scope: Eventual periodicity of PathExists along every natural affine ray (r0+a*n,s0+b*n), with r0,s0 >= 1 and a,b >= 0. A positive period is asserted after some threshold; parameter-one boundaries and constant rays are included. This declaration does not state the separate closed classification.
